title: 中文:基于太极统一场论的分层仿生类脑长期记忆系统 English: Hierarchical Bionic Long-Term Memory System Based on Taiji Unified Field Theory
abstract: 当前大语言模型主流记忆方案包括超长上下文窗口、检索增强RAG、MemGPT分层调度等,这类手段大多停留在工程调度层面,缺少约束系统长期演化的底层第一性原理。普遍存在四类短板:信息持续堆积造成存储冗余、记忆结构碎片化、模型后期出现认知固化,在多轮连续交互过程中智能体人格容易发生漂移。本文以太极统一场论为基础,建立阴阳双场二元公理体系,将阴阳转化规律构建为可计算的信息动力学模型,建立该平衡规律与微积分极限思想之间的数学同构关系,并构造平衡偏离量化指标。在此基础上设计记忆蒸馏分层架构,配套同频共振信息筛选、分层权重衰减遗忘、拓扑记忆自锁、冲突自动校正四项运行机制。系统采用四层分级存储结构,结合知识图谱与向量数据库完成信息降噪、提纯与固化。本文仅完成理论建模与架构设计,从逻辑层面论证各项核心模块的作用,分析该方案对抑制冗余、稳定人格的作用效果。本研究为构建具备长期稳定人设的自主智能体提供一套从基础

title: Securing LLM-Agent Long-Term Memory Against Poisoning: Non-Malleable, Origin-Bound Authority with Machine-Checked Guarantees
abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory, which creates a critical vulnerability that we study here: memory poisoning. An adversary can store untrusted content in one session that later steers a consequential action, such as a payment, a setting change, or data exfiltration, in a future session. title: FeatX: Editing Software by Editing Features for Repository-Level Code Evolution
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for software evolution, yet most interaction paradigms remain code-centric and require manual context management and prompt iteration. We present FeatX, a feature-oriented tool for editing software by editing features. title: MemSyco-Bench: Benchmarking Sycophancy in Agent Memory
abstract: Memory has emerged as a cornerstone of modern LLM-based agents, supporting their evolution from single-turn assistants to long-term collaborators.
